title: About the Authors
text: ANNE RICE & CHRISTOPHER RICE RAMSES THE DAMNED THE PASSION OF CLEOPATRA Anne Rice is the author of thirty-six books, including The Vampire Chronicles and The Lives of the Mayfair Witches. She lives in Southern California. annerice.com Christopher Rice published four New York Times bestselling novels before the age of thirty and has twice been nominated for the Bram Stoker Award. He is the cohost of the YouTube channel The Dinner Party Show with Christopher Rice & Eric Shaw Quinn ( www.tdps.tv ). christopherricebooks.com
